value.rationale: This is the complete exact classification of a natural nonlinear family of derivation operators on every dimension of a standard non-Lie filiform algebra. The jump from two reduced affine components to four in characteristic two creates new dimensions growing with n; every rank is enumerated over every finite field. Projection derivations are equivalent to Z/2 gradings by summands in characteristic two, giving a motivated algebraic interpretation beyond a routine polynomial substitution.
